title: A weekend in Port Alder
subtitle: Two friends, one night by the sea
sample_note: Port Alder is fictional. Everything on this site is sample data for the Trip Cookbook.

days.title: Harbour and market
days.summary: Arrive mid-morning, browse the market, check in, and keep the evening near the harbour.

items.text: Walk to the guesthouse and leave bags at reception
Lunch and a slow lap of the covered market
Lighthouse lookout, or a long coffee if it rains

days.title: Seals, then home
days.summary: One fixed morning on the water, a free afternoon, and the train home.

items.text: Check the harbour office flag before breakfast
Free afternoon: beach, bookshop or a nap
Collect bags and walk to the station

places.name: Harbour guesthouse
places.note: Bags can be left at reception before check-in.

places.name: Harbour office
places.note: The flag mast is visible from the quay.

places.name: The quay
places.note: Several fish stalls; most open from noon.

places.name: The Net Loft
places.note: Upstairs room; ask for the window side.

places.name: Covered market
places.note: Bakery stalls sell out by early afternoon.

todos.text: Confirm the Net Loft dinner table
Check whether a later Sunday train runs
Prepare the site for offline use on both phones

return: From the station: leave by the sea-side exit and follow Station Road downhill.
At the clock tower, turn left onto the quay; Quay Row is the third lane on the right.
help.emergency: Emergency services: call 112 (sample; check the real number for your destination).
